item.text:
<linkedin_post>DoorDash is preparing for customers to order through AI agents even though it has seen only “several hundred” orders in total from third-party agents so far. Most customers still use its app, CEO Tony Xu said.

The company has introduced several ways to order using AI, including a chatbot that accepts prompts and photos and a text-to-order agent. It also offers a way for other chatbots to place corporate orders.

DoorDash wants to work with third-party agent makers, and Xu suggested advertising within those agents could become an opportunity. If customers begin ordering through an agent instead of browsing an app, restaurants and delivery platforms may need new ways to make their offers visible at the point of choice.</linkedin_post>
